gmailSkippedDetails: Ask Kun to request it again whenever you need it.
gmailIntro: Let Kun find and read the email you ask for.
gmailLinkedIntro: {{email}} is connected. Turn it on for this conversation to use it.
gmailReadyDetails: This conversation can read the email you ask for
gmailConsentLead: Connecting lets this conversation use your currently configured models
gmailConsentLeadGrant: Turning this on lets this conversation use your currently configured models
gmailConsentTail: to process the email you ask for. Sending always needs your approval.
gmailLocalCredentials: Google authorization credentials are encrypted on this device and never provided to models or remote devices. Each conversation is turned on separately.
gmailModelDataPolicy: Email follows your selected models, routing and failover settings. Retention and training policies depend on those providers and account settings; Kun makes no universal guarantee. Kun provides no model; we recommend a local model or a service whose terms exclude training on your data. Gmail authorization credentials are never provided to models.
gmailHistoryAndRemoteViewing: Email-related conversation and operational records may remain on this device. If you enable paired-device access, your authenticated device can view this conversation through your selected connection or tunnel. Gmail credentials are not sent to remote devices.
gmailNotConfigured: Gmail is not configured in this app. Update Kun or contact the administrator.
gmailReconnectRequired: Google access expired or was revoked. Connect again.
gmailScopesMissing: Google access is missing required Gmail permissions. Connect again and allow them all.
gmailWaiting: Finish Google authorization in your browser. Kun continues automatically.
gmailCancelled: Connection cancelled. You can retry at any time.
gmailAuthorizationFailed: Google authorization was not completed. Retry and allow the required permissions.
gmailGrantRequired: Turn on Gmail for this conversation first.
gmailStopSharing: Stop using Gmail in this conversation
gmailDisconnectDetails: Disconnecting deletes local Gmail credentials and all conversation grants. Existing history remains until you delete it.
gmailRevokeWarning: Google revocation can remove grants for other Kun clients in this Google project, including Google sign-in. You may need to authorize those clients again. Existing local history remains.
